narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Only the quarter turn works, because a half turn turns the square upside down.
<bookmark mark='look'/>Look at the coaster after two quarter turns. Upside down, it looks exactly the same.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>All four sides are equal, so turning it upside down cannot change its outline.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Every extra quarter turn adds ninety degrees, and the square keeps fitting until the full turn.
